**Bug Fixes**

- Fixed parallel export not handling `Update` and `OnDuplicateKeyUpdate` export modes — these now produce correct output when `EnableParallelProcessing` is enabled
- Fixed `StopAllProcess` potentially throwing exceptions during error cleanup by adding guard checks on `BlockingCollection` and wrapping cancel/stop calls in try-catch
- Hardened `Dispose` to be safely callable multiple times — each resource cleanup is now individually wrapped in try-catch to prevent any single failure fro

- New option for `ExportInfo.GetTotalRowsMode`: `GetTotalRowsMethod.Auto`, which is also the default mode. When there is no progress report events subscribed, it will use `GetTotalRowsMethod.Skip`. When there is progress reporting events subscribed, `GetTotalRowsMethod.SelectCount` will be used.
_Read more: [Understanding Rows Counting Before Export Process in MySqlBackup.NET](https://github.com/MySqlBackupNET/MySqlBackup.Net/wiki/Understanding-Rows-Counting-Before-Export-Process-in-MySqlBackup.NET)_ *

- Introducing the `AdjustColumnValue` feature in `ExportInformations`. This new delegate `(Func<ColumnWithValue, object>)` allows users to dynamically modify column values during export. Paired with the new `ColumnWithValue` class (in `MySqlConnector.InfoObjects`), it provides table name, column name, data type, and value details for custom transformations. Ideal for data masking, formatting, or conditional adjustments, this enhances flexibility while maintaining default behavior when unused.

ODPI-C 26.0.0 is now released. The major version number will now be the two digit year in which that version was first released. This release adds support for setting transaction priority and addresses a number of other issues.

See the [release notes](https://odpi-c.readthedocs.io/en/latest/releasenotes.html#version-26-0-0-september-10-2026) for more information.

ODPI-C 6.0.0 is now released. This release drops support for Oracle Client libraries before 19c and adds support for building with HP-UX aCC, setting and clearing application context entries, and providing the name of the pluggable database associated with a connection. A number of bugs were also fixed.

See the [release notes](https://odpi-c.readthedocs.io/en/latest/releasenotes.html#version-6-0-0-may-4-2026) for more information.

ODPI-C 5.6.4 is now released. This release fixes a number of issues that were discovered.

See the [release notes](https://odpi-c.readthedocs.io/en/latest/releasenotes.html#version-5-6-4-november-11-2025) for more information.
